Public lightweight snapshot: all displayed images are embedded. Raw arrays, model weights and full training data are excluded; download links for excluded assets require the research workspace.
128-step sampling experiment
Same CFM v2 165k checkpoint, 24 targets and 10 seeds. Midpoint sampling: 128 steps / 256 network evaluations. FEM labels, best-of-10 selections and retrievals are recomputed for these images. Open the original 64-step report

The Generated row shows all predefined seeds. FEM is solved independently on each saved binary image. The third row uses the best-of-10 sample selected by actual FEM distance as its query; it does not represent typical random-sample quality. Retrieval is restricted to the corresponding training set. The smaller distance between the original and axis-swapped orientations is used, with duplicate source IDs removed.

Retrieval shows the original, unrotated images: original denotes the original image labels, while matched denotes the axis order used to calculate the distance. Rotation and horizontal mirroring are for visual comparison only; the displayed FEM values always refer to the original global coordinates of the saved image. No visual nearest-neighbor search or automated cat-shape assessment is performed.
